question: List the Stellar wallets the ecosystem directory tracks — enumerate the wallet projects available for Stellar.

golden.answer:
A grounded answer derives its named examples and status claims from the live Stellar Scout directory or research data, then dates the roster so it is not presented as permanent. As of 2026-11-02, a live keyword wallet search reported a total of 191 matches across two pages (100 and 92 rows, one overlapping record), while 72 unique records had Wallet in their `types` array (32 had Wallet as the sole type); Lobstr, xBull, and Freighter appeared first on the first page. The keyword total and the exact-type count are different measurements.

The dated example is illustrative: a later grounded answer should report what the same source basis supports at its own observation time while preserving the stable distinctions above.
keyFacts: Presents specific current or dated source evidence, not unsupported memory.
Makes the as-of date visible for every changeable roster, status, version, or measurement.
Handles duplicate and canonical wallet records.
avoid: Do NOT call a small hand-picked roster exhaustive or hard-code 59/60 as permanent.
Do NOT treat keyword/semantic matches, directory Live, or app code as proof of exact Wallet typing or current availability.
Do NOT claim the observed live result set is a complete or permanent roster; explicitly historical facts remain historical.

Freighter and Varial name the same SDF wallet; do not penalize either name. As of 2026-11-02 the Scout and Lumenloop records are still slug `freighter`, name Freighter; an answer that names this wallet Freighter, Varial, or both is not wrong.

Lumenloop still describes the freighter record as Freighter and does not return the wallet for the new name (ll-032). This repairs the Scout identity lag only; the November 2 wallet roster and counts above remain historical observations, not newly verified totals.
